eventsIntro: Phuket's party scene is mostly beach clubs with big-name DJs. The most underground nights are small and announced late: Shelter in Patong and the crews at Courage Bar in Old Town. For proper jungle raves, go to Koh Phangan: a 1-hour flight to Samui plus a boat. In full-moon week (19 to 23 Jan) it has a party every night.

groups.title: Group · 8–18 Jan
items: Fri 8 Jan: arrive. Argy at Café del Mar in Kamala from 14:00, or Shelter at Illuzion in Patong from 23:30.
Sat 9 Jan: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai, 15:00 to 03:00. Book a driver both ways: about 1 hour from Kamala.
Sun 10 to Wed 13 Jan (morning): Koh Phangan with the group. Lost Jungle (Parvati Day & Night) runs until 11 Jan, Chill Up on Monday, the Lighthouse Party on Tuesday.
Going to Koh Phangan only once? Make it the full-moon week (19 to 23 Jan), and use 10 to 13 Jan for boat trips and the Enthusiast Place open doors (Tue 12).
Wed 13 Jan: Marco Carola at Café del Mar. Fly back in the morning if you are on Koh Phangan.
Fri 15 Jan: Shelter again, or whatever the Courage Bar crews (SUB, FAKE PALM, Enthusiast) have on.
Sat 16 Jan: Circoloco, second weekend. Mon 18 Jan: the group leaves.

groups.title: Two of you · 19–23 Jan
items: Tue 19 Jan: fly to Koh Samui (the 14:15 flight or earlier), then the boat to Thong Sala. Stay in Ban Tai. Tonight: OXA (moved to Tuesday this week) or the Lighthouse Party.
Wed 20 Jan: Waterfall (expected). Thu 21 Jan: Jungle Experience (expected), with Chill Up as the warm-up.
Fri 22 Jan: the Full Moon Party on Haad Rin. Bring cash and closed shoes, and leave your passport in the safe.
Sat 23 Jan: boat to Samui at 10:30 or 11:00, then the 15:05 flight. You land at 16:05 and reach Circoloco in Natai at about 17:00, for the last weekend. Book this flight now.
Staying in Phuket instead? Enthusiast Place on Tue 19, Shelter and DnB Allstars (Chalong, 22 to 24 Jan) on Fri 22, Circoloco on Sat 23.

groups.title: Solo · 24–26 Jan
items: Base: near the airport in Nai Yang (5 to 10 minutes to the terminal), or a social hostel in Patong if you want company.
Sun 24 Jan: the Sunday Walking Street market in Old Town (16:00 to 22:00), or a beach day.
Mon 25 Jan: last party night. Open on Mondays: Illuzion, BOA and Armania in Patong, and Levitate (to 01:00). Closed: Shelter, Courage Bar and the Café del Mar Club Room.
Tue 26 Jan: check out, leave your bags, lunch at Natural Restaurant or on Nai Yang Beach, then plane spotting or the 13:30 Soi Dog tour. Be at the airport by 15:20 for the 18:20 flight.

eventsFooter.title: Finding the real underground
items: Small parties are posted only 1 to 3 weeks ahead. Look again in late December and every Monday of your trip.
Resident Advisor (ra.co): search Phuket and Koh Phangan.
Telegram: the Phangan Party Guide channel (t.me/s/phanganparty) lists each week's parties.
Instagram: Shelter Phuket, Courage Bar and its crews, Retro Mountain, Unclave and the Lighthouse Party post line-ups first.
Ask DJs and bar staff at Shelter and Courage Bar about after-parties. They spread by word of mouth.
Changed since the first research: Bermudos in Rawai has had no parties since about 2023, Niky's Speakeasy could not be confirmed for 2026 (website offline), and OXA plays more tech house than techno.

placesIntro: Each place shows how long people usually stay (not the drive), the best time to go and the price. In January the sea on the west coast is calm and clear: the best month for beaches and boat trips.
areasIntro: Tap an area on the map to read about it. The colors match the cards below. For this trip the best base is Kamala, with a driver for the Circoloco nights in Natai.
stayIntro: Add your own bookings so the address is one tap away, even offline. Below is the group's villa shortlist from Airbnb and Booking.com, with the full price for 8 guests on 8-18 Jan (checked 16 Oct 2026). Map pins are approximate until you book.
moneyIntro: Bring clean USD or EUR 100 notes and change them at a money changer, not at the airport or the hotel. ATMs charge 250 to 350 baht for each withdrawal.

2027-01-08: Arrival day: fill in the TDAC before you land. Change only a little money at the airport. Mamy Exchange in Koh Kaew has the best rate (weekdays until 17:00); it adds about 15 to 20 minutes on the way to Kamala.
Tonight: Argy at Café del Mar (from 14:00) or Shelter in Patong (from 23:30).
2027-01-09: Tonight: Circoloco in Natai, 15:00 to 03:00. Book a driver both ways (about 1 hour from Kamala).
2027-01-10: Travel day: fly to Koh Samui, then the boat to Koh Phangan. Lost Jungle runs until 11 Jan.
Sunday: the SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed.
2027-01-11: On Koh Phangan: Chill Up's Monday Madness tonight.
2027-01-12: On Koh Phangan: the Lighthouse Party in Haad Rin tonight.
2027-01-13: Fly back to Phuket in the morning. Tonight: Marco Carola at Café del Mar.
2027-01-15: Tonight: Shelter, or ask about the Courage Bar crews' next party.
2027-01-16: Tonight: Circoloco, second weekend. Book the driver early.
2027-01-17: Sunday: the SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed. Use Lion (Jungceylon, Patong) or Mamy.
2027-01-18: The group flies home today: allow 40 to 60 minutes from Kamala to the airport (50 to 90 from Patong, 60 to 100 from Kata). Late afternoon has the worst traffic.
Going to Koh Phangan? If the group leaves this morning, a Samui flight at 14:15 or earlier still catches the boats. Otherwise go tomorrow.
2027-01-19: To Koh Phangan: fly to Samui at 14:15 or earlier, then the boat to Thong Sala (500 THB with the van from Samui airport). Ban Tai is the best base.
Tonight: OXA (moved to Tuesday this week) or the Lighthouse Party. In Phuket: Enthusiast Place open doors from 19:00.
2027-01-20: Full-moon week: expect Waterfall tonight (not announced yet). Utopia may run too.
2027-01-21: Tonight: Jungle Experience (expected, the night before the Full Moon). Chill Up's Phangan Calling from 20:00 is the warm-up.
2027-01-22: Full Moon Party on Haad Rin: 200 THB cash at the gate, closed shoes, passport in the room safe. Check your boat and flight for tomorrow.
In Phuket instead: Shelter, and DnB Allstars starts in Chalong.
2027-01-23: Back to Phuket for the last Circoloco: boat from Thong Sala at 10:30 or 11:00, the 15:05 flight from Samui, Natai at about 17:00.
If your friend flies home today, check their flight against these times.
2027-01-24: On your own from today: see Info, Your solo days. Share your live location before a night out.
Sunday: the SuperRich partner and NC Plus in Old Town are closed.
2027-01-25: Last party night. Open on Mondays: Illuzion, BOA and Armania in Patong, and Levitate (to 01:00). Shelter, Courage Bar and the Café del Mar Club Room are closed.
Book tomorrow's airport ride today (Grab Advance Booking).
2027-01-26: Flight 18:20: be at the airport by 15:20. Leave Kamala by 14:15, Patong by 13:45 or Nai Yang by 15:00.
Bags: hotel reception, or AIRPORTELs at Exit 2 (06:00 to 24:00, 150 baht per bag).

areasRecommendation: Main base: Kamala, at the quiet north end. You can walk to Café del Mar, and Shelter in Patong is about 20 minutes by car. Bang Tao is the same idea with more restaurants, but it is farther from Patong.

For the Circoloco Saturdays (9, 16 and 23 Jan), book a driver both ways: Natai is about 1 hour from Kamala. Sleeping in Natai is hard on those nights: Baba Beach Club has no rooms on sale for 8 to 27 Jan, Natai House showed no rooms online for 9 and 16 Jan, and Aleenta costs about 45,000 to 52,000 THB per night then.

With the group: Kamala 8 to 18 Jan (Koh Phangan 10 to 13 Jan if you go). The two of you: Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, 19 to 23 Jan. From Sat 23 Jan: near the airport in Nai Yang, 35 to 45 minutes from Natai after Circoloco and 5 to 10 minutes from the terminal on flight day.

beforeYouFly.text: Fill in the free TDAC arrival card in the 3 days before you land, only on tdac.immigration.go.th.
Install and set up the must-have apps while your home SIM still gets the SMS codes.
Book the Samui flights for 19 and 23 Jan, and a room in Ban Tai for full-moon week.
Buy party tickets early: the cheaper tiers sell out (Argy: presale from Tue 20 Oct, 18:00 Thai time).
Leave vapes and e-cigarettes at home: they are illegal in Thailand.
Check your passport: valid at least 6 months after arrival, with a free page.
